text:
ana: Quick coordination: I'm planning a deploy-window change for APAC edge routing (Tokyo region) next Tue 02:00 UTC. Plan is to shift traffic weight from primary -> canary for 30m warmup, run smoke checks, then finalize. Need owners for smoke checks, a rollback owner, and confirmation that DNS TTLs and health probes are good.

liam: ack, I can own smoke checks for request/latency (will run the script + check dashboards). What's the exact weight change? :eyes:

ana: @liam target is 60% -> 40% primary:canary for warmup, then 20:80 after 30m if all green. We'll do canary service in same AZs, just different routing-policy.

sarah: I'll watch error rates + 5xxs and tail logs. If p50/p95 latency goes >+25% we rollback. I'll set alerts on the dashboards now.

denise: I'll take rollback responsibility. If we need to revert, I'll flip the route policy back to previous weight and run the flush. Also will notify infra.

ana: thanks. platform-oncall, can you hold the DNS TTL/propagation note? TTL is currently 60s for the edge policy. We rely on policy-based weights not pure DNS, but good to validate.

platform-oncall: Confirmed: routing policy weights propagate within ~30s internally. DNS TTL 60s is fine. We'll monitor edge healthprobe success rates during shift.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: RDW-3421. Steps are in the ticket. Rollout window: 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RDW-3421

liam: Smoke checklist I'll run (quick commands):
```
# healthcheck
curl -sS https://api-edge-apac.redwood.example.com/health | jq .status
# sample synthetic load
siege -c20 -t1M https://api-edge-apac.redwood.example.com/predict
```

sarah: For tracing correlation, please include header X-RDW-Canary: true in synthetic runs so traces show canary traffic separately.

ana: Good call. Also, plan B if canary shows partial failures: we try smaller weight (50:50) and re-evaluate for 15m. If errors persist, rollback. Denise will execute rollback.

denise: I'll keep the rollback steps handy: 1) set routing-policy weight back to prior via console/terraform (console quick path below) 2) invalidate local caches if needed 3) run health probe verification 4) announce in #eng-platform and #incidents if wider impact.

ana: Console quick command (if we need immediate revert):
```
# set weight back to primary=80 canary=20
rdwctl routing set-weight --region apac --policy edge-canary --primary 80 --canary 20
```

liam: I'll post results at +5m, +15m, +30m after the initial shift. Sarah will post any alert triggers. Denise please confirm you can act immediately in that window.

denise: I can. I'll be online and have console open. Slack ping @denise if you need the rollback executed.

platform-oncall: We'll keep an eye on upstream peering latency too. If we see cross-region latency spikes, we will drop traffic and notify.

ana: Final checklist before we go:
- Owners: smoke checks=liam, errors=Sarah, rollback=Denise
- Deploy ticket: RDW-3421 (deploy-bot)
- Warmup weights: 60:40 -> monitor 30m -> 20:80 final
- Healthcheck commands and trace header (X-RDW-Canary: true)
- Rollback command and notify channels
- Platform-oncall watching TTL/peering

liam: All set from my side. I'll paste initial healthcheck output in-thread during the shift.

sarah: Alerts set. Will call rollback on +15m if 5xxs > baseline + 1.5x.

denise: Ready. :thumbsup:

ana: Thanks everyone — I'll start the change at 02:00 UTC and will ping 5m before. If anything changes I'll update here.
